settings.title: How to Display & Care
settings.body:
1. Unbox your gnome and gently fluff the realistic evergreen branches, frosted pinecones, and red berries.
2. Insert standard batteries into the concealed bottom compartment and slide the power switch to ON.
3. Display on a sheltered covered porch, entryway console, fireplace hearth, or beside your Christmas tree.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.subtitle: Everything you need to know about sheltered porch placement, LED battery life, dimensions, and our 60-night holiday guarantee.

settings.question: Can I place this gnome outside on my front porch?
settings.answer: Yes! The Christmas Lantern Welcome Gnome is ideal for covered front porches, sheltered entryways, verandas, and indoor living spaces. Because the knit hat and botanical pinecones are textured decorative materials, please keep him under an overhead shelter away from direct heavy rain or snow.

settings.question: How is the star lantern powered and how long does it last?
settings.answer: The star lantern is powered by standard replaceable batteries housed discreetly inside the base compartment. Energy-efficient warm-white LED diodes provide over 120 hours of soft ambient glow across a holiday season.

settings.question: What are the exact dimensions and weight of the gnome?
settings.answer: Each gnome stands approximately 14 inches (35 cm) tall with a 6-inch (15 cm) base diameter and weighs approximately 2.8 lbs (1.3 kg). The weighted base keeps him steady upright on entry tables, mantels, and covered porches.

settings.question: What materials are used for the hat, greenery, and lantern?
settings.answer: The gnome combines a weighted polyresin-stone composite core with a cozy ribbed knit-style cap, plush snowy beard, PE botanical evergreen boughs, natural frosted pinecones, crimson berry accents, and a shatter-resistant LED star lantern.

settings.question: How should I store the gnome after the holidays?
settings.answer: Remove batteries from the base compartment and return the gnome to his foam-cushioned collector box so the knit hat and evergreen sprigs stay crisp and dust-free until next winter.

settings.question: What does the 60-Night Holiday Happiness Guarantee cover?
settings.answer: If you aren't delighted with the craftsmanship or cozy glow within 60 days of delivery, email support@trymalora.com for an effortless return and full refund.

settings.author: Hannah M.
settings.content: This little gnome is hands down the sweetest holiday decoration we've ever bought! The star lantern produces such a gentle, cozy glow on our porch every evening. Everyone who visits stops to take a picture!

settings.author: Thomas & Claire G.
settings.content: We placed him right next to our Christmas tree by the presents. The warm light from his star blends so nicely with the tree lights. The pinecone and greenery textures look so realistic!

settings.author: Margaret B.
settings.content: The craftsmanship on the knitted hat and the snowy beard exceeded my expectations. It feels heavy and well-weighted, so it doesn't tip over. Packaged beautifully too.

settings.author: David S.
settings.content: Bought the 2-pack for our entryway table and fireplace hearth. They create such an inviting, rustic Nordic Christmas vibe. My grandchildren adore them!

settings.author: Jessica K.
settings.content: The glowing star lantern at night is pure magic. It has a warm amber-white tone that isn't glaring at all. Battery lasts forever. Highly recommended!

settings.author: Robert P.
settings.content: The attention to detail with the berries and pine boughs gives it such an authentic woodland character. Exactly as pictured, arrived in 3 days.

settings.author: Evelyn W.
settings.content: Super cute holiday centerpiece! Heavy enough to stay upright on our windy covered porch. Will be buying a couple more as gifts.

settings.author: Brian L.
settings.content: Very well made decoration. Looks great at night. Wish the battery switch was a tiny bit easier to reach without lifting, but otherwise 10/10.

settings.author: Samantha D.
settings.content: Brought so much festive spirit into our foyer. Quality is wonderful and the star light is warm and comforting.

settings.author: Arthur N.
settings.content: Outstanding quality. You can tell it's not cheap hollow plastic. It has genuine weight and the knitted texture is lovely.
